card.name: Dosing words in label headings
card.fires_on: Pieces of dose-related words in drug labels, such as the 'min' in coadministration, 'dose' or 'dosing' after maintenance or frequency of, and 'be' after 'dosage ... should'.

modes.label: Coadministration
modes.description: The 'min' piece inside coadministration at the start of an interaction statement.

modes.label: Dose and dosing
modes.description: The word dose or dosing (or its first piece) after loading, maintenance or frequency of.
modes.example: The maximum of any individual loading or daily maintenance<< dose>> to be administered to any pediatric patient is

modes.label: Should be after dosage
modes.description: The word 'be' in 'dosage ... in adult patients should be based on'.
modes.example: The dosage of Imipenem and Cilastatin for Injection (I.V.) in adult patients should<< be>> based on suspected or confirmed pathogen susceptibility
